subject_definitions:
- <Subject 1>: The same photorealistic young adult East Asian woman shown in <Picture 1>: round soft-featured face, fair clear skin with natural texture, straight dark eyebrows, dark brown eyes with visible double eyelids, small nose, natural coral-pink lips, and a short black bob cut to the jaw with a straight blunt fringe across the forehead and slightly rounded ends. Slim, petite proportions.
- <Subject 2>: Her outfit from <Picture 1>: a fitted spaghetti-strap camisole with a fine multicolor floral print on a white ground and a slightly ruffled square neckline, high-waisted off-white tailored shorts with a clean front crease, and simple white slip-on flat shoes with soft rounded toes.
- <Subject 3>: The pink baseball cap from <Picture 2>: faded baby-pink washed cotton twill, an unstructured six-panel crown, a pink-covered matching top button, a stitched eyelet on the side panel, a curved pink brim with double rows of stitching, and bold navy-blue raised three-dimensional embroidery across the front panel reading AIJUXI. Worn on her head, seated down over the crown with the brim level and angled slightly forward.
- <Subject 4>: The pink-framed glasses from <Picture 3>: glossy pink acetate frames, square lens shape with softly rounded corners, medium-thick rims, clear transparent non-tinted lenses, small silver metal rivets at the outer front corners, and slim pink temples. Worn correctly on the bridge of her nose with the temples resting over her ears and the lenses centered in front of her eyes.
- <Subject 5>: An open urban rooftop at night: dark concrete flooring with faint sheen, low perimeter walls, evenly spaced warm safety lights, a dense illuminated modern skyline, a deep navy sky, and one bright full moon.
- <Picture 1>: The primary character reference, defining <Subject 1>'s face, hairstyle, fringe, skin, body proportions and <Subject 2>. It is a multi-angle model sheet, not a storyboard; use it for identity and costume only, and ignore its white studio background and static pose.
- <Picture 2>: The costume reference for <Subject 3> only, defining the cap's exact pink hue, crown shape, brim curve, stitching, and the navy embroidered lettering. Do not copy its white background, studio lighting, or floating presentation.
- <Picture 3>: The costume reference for <Subject 4> only, defining the frame shape, frame thickness, glossy pink color, and silver corner rivets. Do not copy its white background, and do not carry over any reflection, highlight, or distortion from the product photo.
summary:
reference generation + keyframe completion. Create a 10-second photorealistic cinematic rooftop dance video of <Subject 1> wearing <Subject 2>, with <Subject 3> on her head and <Subject 4> on her face, inside <Subject 5>. There is no storyboard grid in this task; the five shots below are the authoritative shot order. The sequence progresses from a distant rooftop introduction to a confident walk, an expressive low-angle gesture, a controlled spin, and a final moonlit pose.
retention_analysis:
- <Subject 1> — fully_preserved: retain the same round face, eye shape, eyebrows, small nose, natural lip shape, fair skin texture, the short black bob with its straight blunt fringe, and her slim proportions in every shot.
- <Subject 2> — fully_preserved: retain the exact floral camisole print and ruffled neckline, the off-white high-waisted shorts with their front crease, and the white slip-on flats.
- <Subject 3> — fully_preserved: retain the exact faded pink hue, unstructured crown shape, brim curve and stitching, and the navy AIJUXI embroidery; the cap stays seated on her head at the same angle in all five shots, with the fringe emerging beneath the brim.
- <Subject 4> — fully_preserved: retain the exact glossy pink frame color, square rounded lens shape, frame thickness, and silver corner rivets; the glasses stay correctly positioned on her nose in all five shots.
- <Subject 5> — fully_preserved: retain the rooftop geometry, concrete sheen, skyline arrangement, night lighting, and the single moon.
detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action nighttime cinematography with crisp natural skin texture, fine individual hair strands in the fringe and bob, detailed cotton twill weave and embroidery relief on the cap, sharp focus on the glossy acetate frames with restrained specular highlights, printed fabric detail in the floral camisole, shallow depth of field, cool city illumination, and warm rooftop edge lights. Maintain grounded human movement and physically believable balance in flat slip-on shoes, with the cap and glasses behaving as real worn objects under gravity and motion. Keep the pacing brisk and continuous so the action reads within ten seconds.
[Shot 1] 0.00-2.00s. A very wide symmetrical rooftop shot. She stands small in the distance beneath the moon, wearing <Subject 2> with <Subject 3> on her head and <Subject 4> on her face, arms relaxed at her sides. The camera performs a smooth, moderately fast forward dolly of approximately four meters as she shifts her weight and takes two poised steps toward the camera while the skyline remains stable. The brim sits level, the pink frames catch one small point of warm light, and her eyes stay readable inside the clear lenses.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a full-body medium-wide shot. The camera tracks backward at walking speed as she crosses one leg elegantly in front of the other, rolls one shoulder, and lets her arms swing naturally with the walk. With two fingers she lightly tugs the front of the cap brim down once, then drops her hand. Her flat shoes contact the concrete softly and correctly, her shorts and the loose ends of her bob move with the rooftop breeze, and the cap does not shift from its seated position.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, cut to a dramatic low-angle medium close-up with a slight upward tilt. She plants her feet apart, leans toward the lens, and extends her right hand forward in one fluid expressive gesture, then sweeps it down beside her hip. The low angle looks up beneath the brim, so her eyes, eyebrows and the full pink frame shape remain clearly visible, with the underside of the brim and the embroidered lettering reading cleanly above her forehead. Her gaze stays locked on the lens.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, cut to a dynamic three-quarter full-body shot with a restrained ten-degree Dutch angle. She completes one controlled clockwise spin with her arms opening outward for balance. The blunt fringe and the ends of her bob sweep outward in one continuous arc from beneath the cap, her camisole hem lifts slightly and her shorts move with realistic inertia, and she lands evenly on both flat shoes. The cap stays firmly seated through the rotation and the glasses do not slide down her nose.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, cut to a moonlit medium portrait. She settles into the final pose with one hand raised loosely near her temple and the other resting lightly against her hip. The camera slowly pushes in by 6%. Her hair settles, she raises her chin, and finishes with the same warm, soft, confident smile she has in <Picture 1>, looking straight into the camera. The full moon remains visible beside her head, and the pink frames hold a clean edge without flare or ghosting.
Maintain one facial identity, one hairstyle with the same blunt fringe, exact cap color, brim shape and legible navy AIJUXI embroidery, exact pink frame color and thickness, correct fingers, stable legs, and consistent shoe construction. She never removes or repositions the cap or the glasses except for the single brim tug in Shot 2. No storyboard grid, panel borders, numbers, split screen, duplicated moon, additional people, changing skyline, warped hands, foot sliding, excessive spinning, sudden costume changes, missing or duplicated cap, cap worn backwards, cap clipping through hair, embroidered text misspelled or drifting, floating or doubled glasses, opaque or tinted lenses, any text or logo other than the cap embroidery, subtitles, or watermarks.
overall_soundscape:
Steady rooftop wind, distant city traffic, faint urban hum, soft flat-shoe footsteps on concrete, a light fabric tap at the brim tug, and natural cotton, shorts and hair movement. No dialogue.
non_diegetic_music:
Stylish electronic dance music at approximately 112 BPM, with a controlled synth bass, crisp restrained beat, and a brief rise during the spin before resolving on the final pose.
